const input = $('Verify owner and item').first()?.json ?? {};
const hidden = input.action === 'hide';
const reopened = ['reopen', 'release', 'renew'].includes(input.action);
const reserved = input.action === 'reserve';
const message = hidden
  ? 'Publicación borrada'
  : input.action === 'renew'
    ? 'Publicación renovada'
    : input.action === 'reopen'
      ? 'Publicación reactivada'
      : reserved
        ? 'Publicación reservada'
        : input.action === 'release'
          ? 'Reserva liberada'
          : 'Marcado como entregado';
return [{ json: {
  ok: true,
  item_id: input.item_id ?? '',
  title: input.title ?? '',
  status: input.status ?? (hidden ? 'hidden' : reopened ? 'available' : reserved ? 'reserved' : 'completed'),
  expires_at: input.expires_at ?? null,
  renewal_count: input.renewal_count ?? 0,
  completed_at: input.completed_at ?? null,
  reserved_at: input.reserved_at ?? null,
  reservation_expires_at: input.reservation_expires_at ?? null,
  reservation_days: input.reservation_days ?? null,
  renewal_days: input.renewal_days ?? null,
  message,
} }];
